question: The President of India, Droupadi Murmu, conferred which Jnanpith Award on the Sanskrit scholar Jagadguru Rambhadracharya in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is** 58th.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jnanpith Award** is one of the highest literary honors in India, awarded annually by the Bharatiya Jnanpith organization to an author for their outstanding contribution to literature.
 
• The **58th **Jnanpith Award was conferred upon **Jagadguru Rambhadracharya**, a renowned Sanskrit scholar, in **May 2025**. This indicates his exceptional literary contributions in the Sanskrit language.
 
• **Jagadguru Rambhadracharya** is widely recognized for his profound knowledge in the Sanskrit language, and his works are celebrated for their depth and richness.
 
• The award ceremony was presided over by **Droupadi Murmu**, the **President of India**, showcasing the significance of this prestigious event.
 
• The Jnanpith Award has been presented annually since its inception in **1961**. It honors literary figures across all recognized languages in India as per the **Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jnanpith Award:**

 
 
• The award was instituted in **1961** by the Bharatiya Jnanpith organization.
 
• It recognizes authors who write in any of the **22 languages** listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The award consists of a cash prize, a citation, and a bronze replica of Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge.
 
• Prominent recipients include **G. Sankara Kurup**, the first awardee, and other literary stalwarts like **Raghuvir Sahay**, **Amrita Pritam**, and **Shankha Ghosh**.
 
 
 
• **Jagadguru Rambhadracharya:**
 
 
• He is a **prolific scholar and writer**, known for his significant contributions to Sanskrit literature.
 
• He is also recognized as a **spiritual leader** and holds the title of **Jagadguru**.
 
• Rambhadracharya is known for his work in translating and interpreting Hindu scriptures and for his poetry, essays, and literary compositions.
 
• His contributions have elevated the status of Sanskrit literature in contemporary times.
 
 
 
• **Droupadi Murmu:**
 
 
• She is the **15th President of India** and the first tribal woman to hold the office.
 
• Her presidency is marked by a focus on inclusivity and the recognition of India's diverse cultural and literary heritage.
 
• Presiding over the award ceremony highlights her role in promoting Indian literature and culture.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Jnanpith Award:**
 
 
• The award is a recognition of **excellence in Indian literature**, celebrating authors whose works contribute to the nation’s literary legacy.
 
• It underscores the importance of preserving and promoting literary works in India's diverse languages.
 
• The award has evolved over the years to include works in modern and classical literature.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Selection Process:**

 
 
• The recipient of the Jnanpith Award is chosen by a panel of scholars and experts in literature.
 
• It involves a rigorous process to ensure that the awardee has made a substantial contribution to their respective language and literature.
 
 
 
• **Languages Covered:**
 
 
• Initially, the award was only given for works in **Hindi**, but it later expanded to include all recognized languages under the Eighth Schedule.
 
• This inclusivity has helped promote literature across various regions in India.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The Jnanpith Award has played a pivotal role in encouraging authors to contribute to India's rich literary heritage.
 
• It has helped preserve classical and modern works, ensuring their relevance to future generations.
